provenance.capture_mode: Production-style supervisor; vendor stdin DEVNULL, stdout/stderr PIPE
provenance.configuration: Fresh owned HOME, USERPROFILE, XDG paths, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and TMPDIR per invocation; --setting-sources empty. No real user files mounted.
provenance.authentication: Synthetic dummy ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9. No provider invocation.
provenance.traffic: Auto-updates, telemetry, error reporting and nonessential traffic disabled.
provenance.normalization: Only /owned/settings.json is replaced with <settings-file> in argv/stdout/stderr. All other captured bytes, including synthetic HOME paths and installation warnings, are retained. raw_*_sha256 identifies the unmodified streams.
provenance.bounds: 12 seconds and 512 KiB per stream per command; owned process-group cleanup after each invocation.
provenance.scope: Observed Claude Code 2.1.323 doctor protocol only; no claim about other versions, wrappers, provider or browser behavior.
